offering_description.value: Urban One produces television, radio and digital programming primarily for Black American audiences. It distributes programming through pay-TV providers, its own radio stations, syndicated radio affiliates and digital properties, and sells advertising across those channels.

primary_products.value: cable television programming; local radio programming; syndicated radio shows; digital editorial and video content

primary_services.value: television, radio and digital advertising; sponsored content production; radio program syndication

customer_segment.value: B2B: National and local advertisers, media buying agencies, pay-TV providers and affiliate radio stations; B2C: Pay-TV households that buy packages carrying its networks, primarily serving Black American audiences

end_markets.value: pay television; broadcast radio; digital media; advertising

revenue_model.value: advertising: Commercial spots, digital ad placements and sponsorships; licensing or royalties: Carriage fees from pay-TV providers for distributing its cable networks, generally based on subscriber counts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Produces and acquires programming, then supplies it to pay-TV providers and radio affiliates and sells audience access to advertisers; asset operator: Runs licensed stations that broadcast locally produced and syndicated programs to listeners and sell airtime to advertisers

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide pay-TV, syndicated radio and digital reach, with owned stations in selected US metropolitan markets

specialization.value: related lines: Cable television, local radio, syndicated radio and digital media focused on Black American audiences

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Cable, satellite and streaming TV providers and affiliated radio stations; direct sales: National and local sales teams serving advertisers and media agencies; online: Owned websites, digital publications and station streams; other: Over-the-air broadcasts from owned radio stations
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; direct sales; online; other

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Terrestrial radio stations require FCC licenses and are subject to broadcast ownership and operating rules

notes: The current scope of live-event operations is uncertain.
